en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornamental fountain and pond in a landscaped garden. The foreground is a large circular water basin with aquatic plants and decorative urns along the edge. In the background stands an elaborate stone fountain structure with statuary and lush trees behind it. Handwritten Cyrillic text appears along the bottom border of the image.
